intro.text: Rolling Hills Property Services keeps Suffolk County homes and businesses looking sharp all year. Spring and fall cleanups, weekly lawn care, fresh mulch and plantings, privacy trees, paver walkways and driveway paving, then snow removal and salting when winter hits. Owner Ron and his crew handle it all, so you don't have to juggle five different companies.
intro.quote: From the first mow of spring to the last snowstorm, one crew that knows your property.
